title: Fix 1-based pagination and add page_count
goal: Make shop.pagination.paginate treat pages as 1-based and add shop.pagination.page_count, as documented in the module docstring.
acceptance_criteria: paginate(items, page, per_page) returns the items of the 1-based page; the last page may be partial; a page past the end returns []
paginate raises ValueError for page < 1 or per_page < 1
paginate accepts any iterable and never mutates its input
page_count(total, per_page) returns the number of pages (0 for 0 items) and raises ValueError for per_page < 1
